patients.summary: Warehouse loader with cervical spondylosis and multilevel disc disease, treated hypertension, post-laminectomy mechanical low back pain and knee osteoarthritis, who joined in 2022. A left cervical radiculopathy in 2024 settled with therapy; a right C7 radiculopathy after overhead lifting in late 2025 was improving at his last visit.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT

53M transferring from another primary care office closer to his old address. Wants one place to call. Main issues are his neck, his back and his knees, and BP which he says has been fine on lisinopril.

HTN: lisinopril 10 daily for years per his account, takes it in the morning, no home cuff. No headaches beyond the usual, no chest symptoms.
Neck: told years ago he has arthritis and disc wear in the neck at two levels (C5-6, C6-7). Stiff after a long shift, no arm symptoms now.
Low back: L4-5 laminectomy this past spring at an outside spine group for leg pain, that's gone. Still gets a mechanical ache across the low back with bending and lifting. Back at work full duty since early summer.
Knees: both ache on stairs and after a day on the dock floor. No locking.
Uses ibuprofen 600 up to three times a day on bad days, cyclobenzaprine 5 at night now and then for spasm, Tylenol 500 for a headache.

PSH: L rotator cuff repair 2016; L4-L5 laminectomy 2022.
Allergies: sulfa (hives); shellfish, doesn't know what happened, was told as a kid to avoid it.
FH: father had neck arthritis that went on to myelopathy, and HTN. Mother with OA and osteoporosis. Older brother had a neck fusion for a pinched nerve.
SH: loads trucks at a distribution warehouse, 30+ years of lifting. Quit cigarettes 2019 after about 20 pack-years. A beer or two on weekends.

Exam: well-appearing, large frame. BP as charted. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear. Neck: reduced rotation both ways, no tenderness, Spurling negative bilaterally. Upper extremity strength, sensation and reflexes symmetric. Low back: healed midline scar, paraspinal tightness, straight leg raise negative. Knees: crepitus both, no effusion, stable.

A/P
1. HTN, at goal on lisinopril 10. Continue.
2. Cervical spondylosis with DDD, quiet. Lifting technique, keep moving.
3. Mechanical LBP after laminectomy, OA knees. As-needed meds as he has them.
4. Former smoker, qualifies for annual lung screening CT. Discussed what it is and what a false alarm looks like; he wants it. Ordered.
5. Tdap today. Baseline labs, HCV and HIV screening today.
6. Records release signed for prior PCP.
RTC 6 months, sooner as needed.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Douglas, your blood work from Wednesday is all normal: kidney function, liver tests, blood counts, cholesterol and sugar. Hepatitis C and HIV screens were negative. Nothing to change. Watch for a call to schedule the lung CT.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Received from prior primary care office, 38 pages. Indexed:
- Problem list: hypertension; cervical spondylosis with degenerative disc disease C5-C6 and C6-C7; low back pain; osteoarthritis of both knees.
- Medication list: lisinopril 10 mg daily; ibuprofen 600 mg TID PRN; cyclobenzaprine 5 mg QHS PRN; acetaminophen 500 mg PRN.
- Allergies: sulfa (hives), shellfish.
- Spine surgery discharge summary, spring 2022: L4-L5 laminectomy, uncomplicated, discharged home day 1.
- Screening colonoscopy report, 2019: complete exam, no polyps found, 10-year interval advised.
- Office notes and lab reports 2019-2022.
Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Outside records review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed prior office packet. Matches his history. Colonoscopy 2019 clean, next due 2029. BP readings there mostly 130s/80s. Nothing outstanding.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came after his shift for flu vaccine. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. Tolerated, waited without problems, left ambulatory.

reports.study: Low-dose CT chest for lung cancer screening
reports.text:
LOW-DOSE CT CHEST, LUNG CANCER SCREENING, BASELINE
Indication: former smoker, 20 pack-years, quit 2019.
Technique: low-dose helical CT of the chest without contrast.
Comparison: none.
Findings: No pulmonary nodules. Lungs clear without consolidation or emphysema. Airways patent. No pleural effusion. Heart normal in size, no pericardial effusion. No enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes. Visualized upper abdomen unremarkable. Mild degenerative change in the thoracic spine.
reports.conclusion: Lung-RADS 1, negative. Continue annual screening in 12 months.

documents.title: Lung screening result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your lung screening CT was clear, no nodules. We'll repeat it each November while you qualify.

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
BP check. Feels fine. Taking lisinopril every day. Busy season at the warehouse, back and knees sore at the end of the week, ibuprofen a few days a week, cyclobenzaprine once or twice a month. Neck stiff but no arm symptoms.

Exam: BP as charted, at goal. Heart regular. Lungs clear. No edema.

A/P: HTN controlled on lisinopril 10, continue. BMP today. First Shingrix today, second in 6 months, he'll do it at his physical. Physical in September.

documents.title: BMP result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Kidney function and potassium normal on the lisinopril. All good.

documents.title: RE: shingles shot

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
PHYSICAL, 54M

Doing well. Same job, same aches. Knees worst on the loading ramp; low back ache most evenings, eases with stretching he learned after surgery. Neck stiff turning to back up the forklift, no arm pain or numbness. Ibuprofen most workdays lately, he says. No GI upset, no dark stools.

ROS otherwise negative. PHQ-2 0.

Exam: BP as charted. HEENT clear. Neck reduced rotation, no tenderness. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Knees with crepitus, no effusion. Neuro: strength 5/5 and reflexes 2+ symmetric in the arms and legs.

A/P
- HTN controlled on lisinopril 10.
- Neck, back, knees: stable on his PRNs. Reviewed lifting mechanics.
- Prevention: Shingrix #2 and flu today. Colonoscopy 2019 normal, next 2029. Lung CT due in November, ordered. CMP and lipids today.
RTC 6 months.

documents.title: Physical labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from your physical look good. Cholesterol is in a fine range, kidney and liver numbers normal.

LOW-DOSE CT CHEST, ANNUAL SCREENING
Comparison: 11/9/2022.
Findings: No pulmonary nodules. No consolidation, no emphysema. Central airways clear. No pleural or pericardial effusion. Heart size normal. No adenopathy. Upper abdomen unremarkable. Stable mild thoracic spondylosis.
reports.conclusion: Lung-RADS 1, negative. Annual screening in 12 months.
